polls.publication_date_basis: January 22 release date explicitly stated in Osborn campaign release republished by Huskeradio January 27; PDF itself undated.
polls.party_question: Party registration on file: Republican, Democrat, unaffiliated or other; not respondent party identification. Self-ID asked separately in Q40, but ballot is not cross-tabulated on it.
polls.ballot_question_stage: Two-candidate first-choice; sum strong and not-so-strong percentages before undecided lean probe
polls.source_location: PDF pp. 1, 6 Q6 registration columns; p. 7 Q40
polls.evidence_excerpt: D/R/unaff-other first-choice strong + not strong: Ricketts 6+0/57+16/15+9, Osborn 69+19/12+6/48+15. Lean-inclusive totals 7/75/27 and 89/19/66 respectively.
polls.notes: Registration proxy combines unaffiliated/other; reported D/R/other N=234/483/183 but weighting status unspecified, so subgroup Ns null. Sums are arithmetic on rounded components, can differ from unrounded first-choice aggregate by one percentage point. Q6 asked two-candidate hypothetical; do not use 2024 race. PDF says oversample of 100 NE-02 Democratic primary voters; statewide table labels N=900 likely voters; oversample not added to total.
